d: How do you search through lakhs of voter list PDFs without spending hours scrolling? An 18-year-old ethical hacker from Ranchi, Sarthak Sidhant, has attempted to solve this problem. He and his team have digitised 6.8 lakh PDF files containing Uttar Pradesh's electoral rolls, converting them into 54.8 crore searchable data entries. Using Optical Character Recognition (OCR), the project brings together four sets of electoral rolls across all 403 Assembly constituencies. We speak to Sidhant about how the database works, data privacy safeguards and why making electoral rolls machine-readable…
